## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmations: narrow sector participation with Energy/Utilities/Industrials leading while mega-cap Tech shows mixed short-term weakness, and a MAJOR divergence among large caps (AAPL/MSFT/META showing 1W vs 1M discord) — suppress strong directional calls.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +10.48%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials: LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION. Communication Services weak: TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 split across Industrials, Utilities, Materials).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -11.60% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND; SHOP (1W: -10.44% | 1M: +4.01%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in select Tech and high-beta names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY. Note MAJOR divergence among large caps (AAPL, MSFT, META) — tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-lagging with concentrated downside in mega-caps: NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND but GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION; sector showing internal rotation given broad 1W weakness across Tech (24 stocks majority negative).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Neutral-to-soft: JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND but Financials sector 1W -1.70% overall; V (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -3.85% | 1M: +8.83%) CORRECTION — mixed leadership, watch for follow-through.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mild strength but uneven: JNJ (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND, while ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND highlights idiosyncratic risk; sector 1W -0.77% with patchy internals.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Energy and Utilities names showing ABOVE TREND (XOM, CVX, VST) and selectively to Industrials (LMT, HON); reduce exposure to high-beta Tech names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, TSLA). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given divergent tech vs cyclical flows and a concentrated top-performer set.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; RTX (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (sector 1W: +4.06%, showing strong breadth among leaders) and Utilities (sector 1W: +2.71%). BEARISH: Technology (sector 1W: -3.49%) and Communication Services (sector 1W: -4.40%) — watch for further dispersion within Tech.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
XOM continuation level: monitor near recent breakout / follow-through zone given ABOVE TREND momentum; NVDA retest of near-term support given modest 1W gain while ABOVE TREND; AAPL support levels as CORRECTION may dictate tech sentiment if breached.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
EA (+90): EU clears PIF acquisition — EA (1W: data not in top list) monitor for confirming price action; NVDA (+65): Nvidia talks backing OpenAI data center — NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment largely confirming price strength. TMO (+80): Thermo Fisher raises outlook — TMO (1W: not in top list) watch for follow-through; PM (+85): FDA Modified Risk — PM (1W: not in top list) monitor; PYPL (+80): PayPal board news — PYPL (1W: not in top list) watch price for divergence.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
IBM (-50): weak hardware spending headline — IBM (1W: not listed) watch for confirming weakness. CMCSA (-50): analyst trims and subscriber worries — CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed. XOM (-45) / CVX (-45) negative headlines on oil prices are diverging from price strength: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +10.48%) ABOVE TREND — watch for price reaction if headlines persist.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership given Energy/Utilities/Industrials strength versus Tech softness. XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, and LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among mega-caps (AAPL/MSFT/META CORRECTION patterns) and mixed news sentiment that could flip internals quickly — watch for trend confirmation.
